description: Non-material amendment to planning permission ref. 79678/APP/2025/2383, dated 04-11-2025 (Conversion of roof space to habitable use, erection of a single storey rear extension and erection of an outbuilding (following demolition of existing conservatory)) to include adjustments to the internal layout, including repositioning of internal partitions, alterations to room arrangements and removal of the existing side entry door including the adjustment to the size and re-positioning of windows to reflect the revised internal layout. Alternation to the position and footprint of the proposed outbuilding within the rear garden, including its relationship with the existing site boundaries and introduction of a canopy to the outbuilding.
decision_conditions: The proposed plans indicate amendments which would result in an increase in the scale, volume and height of the built form and a change in the design and appearance of the development. The proposed changes cannot be considered as non-material as they represent a form of development beyond the scope of the planning approval. The potential impacts therefore need to be considered as part of a new planning application.
